title: ETHDollar
tagline: Account base loans to mint stable coin. Loans have to be repay to prevent defaulting.
description:
Using onchain oracle Chainlink to create loan system to prevent liquidation during flash crash on deposited loan. Allow users to take position when they feel that the price of Ether is overvalue or undervalue.
Demo is not working yet. Due to Error in Webpack. will fix it soon.
how_its_made:
Built with Chainlink pricefeed with ERC20 and Governance Smart contract. 

Chainlink , ERC20 , Openzepplin , Next , react.
